question: The term 'shooting guard' is used in which of the following games/sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shooting guard** is a **position in basketball**, typically played by a player who is adept at shooting from the perimeter and creating their own shot.
 
• **Basketball is a team sport**, where each team consists of five players who are each given a certain position on the court. These Positions are:
 
 
• **Point Guard**
 
• **Shooting Guard**
 
• **Small Forward**
 
• **Power Forward**
 
• **Center**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tennis is an individual sport** where players use rackets to hit a ball over a net and into the opponent's court.
 
• **Table **tennis is an individual sport where two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small bats.
 
• **Terms used in Table Tennis**:
 
 
• Chop
 
• Lob
 
• Rally
 
• Deuce
 
• Pips
 
 
 
• **Volleyball is a team sport** where two teams of six players are separated by a net and try to score points by grounding the ball on the opponent's court.
 
• Volleyball positions are as follows:
 
 
• **Setter**
 
• **Outside Hitter**
 
• **Opposite Hitter**
 
• **Middle Blocker**
 
• **Libero** (Libero stands out from the other players on the team due to their **distinct colored jerseys**)
 
• **Defensive Specialist**
